column1: # Manually confirmed DOIs, applied by build_doi_manifest.py.
# Automated resolution cannot settle every row: corpus.yaml records abbreviated
# titles, some papers are not indexed by Crossref or arXiv, and a longer
# published title that merely begins with the corpus title is often a different
# paper. Rather than hand-edit the generated manifest, which the next rebuild
# would silently discard, record confirmed DOIs here with the evidence.

column3: Confirmed 2026-07-31 against arXiv metadata: Choquette-Choo, Tramer, Carlini, Papernot, 2020, title exact. The resolver had matched "Label-Only Membership Inference Attack against Node-Level Graph Neural Networks", a different paper sharing the title prefix; the author check flagged it.

column1: Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification for Ocean Alkalinity Enhancement
column3: Confirmed 2026-07-31 against Crossref: Ho, Bopp, Palter, Long, Boyd, Neukermans, 2023, State of the Planet. Title matches exactly; the resolver's author check failed on a parsing artifact, not a real disagreement.

column1: Biological Response of Eelgrass Epifauna to Elevated Ocean Alkalinity
column3: Confirmed 2026-07-31 against Crossref: Jones, Hemery, Ward, Regier, Ringham, Eisaman, 2025, Biogeosciences. The corpus records a short form of the published title, which names the two study species.

column3: Confirmed 2026-07-31 against Crossref: Schneider, Riebesell, Moras, Marin-Samper, Kittu, Ortiz-Cortes, 2025. NOTE: this is the EGUsphere preprint (type posted-content). If a final Biogeosciences version exists and is what was ingested, swap this DOI for it.

column3: Confirmed 2026-07-31 against arXiv metadata: Sky Qiu first of 21 authors, 2026-04-11, title exact. Not indexed by Crossref, which is why the automated pass found only unrelated economics trial registrations.
